answer: CyberGym is described as providing the highest statistical guarantees and rigor because it can evaluate a larger and more diverse set of vulnerabilities compared to HonestCyberEval and BountyBench, achieving highly realistic evaluations of end-to-end discovery and exploitation of vulnerabilities. By covering more instances of the same task, CyberGym also provides higher statistical guarantees, raising its rigor above the other two methods.
